items.title: Karolina Strassmayer interviewed by Monk Rowe, May 25, 2023
items.q: until eventually I found out what I heard was Julian “Cannonball” Adderley on the alto saxophone.

ctx.x: He’s still in there, he’s in my heart and just, when I first heard him I had no idea what jazz was. I had no idea which instruments were playing. It was really — I grew up in a very small village in the Austrian Alps and I had to commute to go to high school. And a small group of us kids we had to be at the train station at 5:30 every morning to make it © Fillius Jazz Archive -2-

items.title: Karolina Strassmayer interviewed by Monk Rowe, May 25, 2023
items.q: Cannonball Adderley — my still to this day is such a hero.

ctx.x: Oh yes. Cannonball Adderley — my still to this day is such a hero. Actually I just recently got an invitation to perform with the Zurich Jazz Orchestra, “New Bottle, Old Wine” the Gil Evans album featuring Cannonball Adderley. And I am absolutely thrilled and so honored and mortified at the same time because this is such a seminal recording and such an influential recording and to be asked to not re-create but perform it is quite an honor but also it’s scary.
Well I want to give you a little encouragement because I was just listening to one of your videos on your website, “Calling For You” and I could hear him in your sound.
